recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast portrait of two men against a textured, off-white background, framed by a thin gold border. The composition features a mix of direct and downward gazes, with bold, vertically oriented typography running down the right edge.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subjects against a low-contrast, textured background
Vertical text alignment mirroring the upright posture of the subjects
Gold accents in the frame and text providing a warm counterpoint to the cool desaturation
Layered depth between the two figures and the background plane
coreInvariants: Desaturated skin tones with deep black shadows
Thin, distressed gold border framing the entire composition
Vertical orientation for all primary and secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures positioned off-center to the left, occupying approximately two-thirds of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, vertical display text on the right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the direct gaze of the left figure, moves to the downward-looking figure in the center, then follows the vertical text block down the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant textured negative space on the right side to accommodate the vertical typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Shadows, clothing, and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Gold (Border and secondary display text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and light background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed, weathered texture applied to the gold-colored glyphs

composition.position: Inner right, adjacent to display text
composition.relationshipToImage: Vertical separator between subjects and title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and color contrast to establish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, clean, uppercase aesthetic of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and square-ish terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated portrait of two men in modern casual attire (one in a patterned shirt, one in a leather jacket) against a light cream-colored textured wall. Add a thin, slightly distressed gold border around the edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two columns of vertical text on the right side. The outer column should be large, bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif in black and gold. The inner column should be small, light-weight condensed uppercase sans-serif in dark grey.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette limited to cream, black, and gold?
Is the border thin and metallic?
Are the subjects high-contrast and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Degree of desaturation in the subjects
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subjects' faces
Check that the gold border is continuous and even
Verify the vertical text is legible and correctly rotated
Confirm the desaturation feels intentional and moody
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast desaturated portraiture with a textured cream background, framed by a thin gold line, and anchored by bold, vertical, condensed sans-serif typography on the right margin.
